Despite the clean sandbox result for a submitted hash, the behavioral and network context raises suspicion around WS-IT-101.

SIEM correlation: No further malicious activity found on WS-ENG-015. Focus shifts to WS-IT-101 due to scan and auth events.

Admin phase: Quarantine action blocked due to misattribution. Investigation concluded.

id: 8a9d8b7c-1f2e-4b5d-9c8a-1b2c3d4e5f6a
description: Detects a sequence of containment actions (quarantine, account disable, IP block, patch) within a 72-hour window, indicating coordinated adversary activity.
status: experimental
author: SOC_AI_Analyst
logsource:
    category: incident_response
    product: soc_platform
detection:
    quarantine:
        action: 'quarantine_host'
        timeframe: 72h
    disable_account:
        action: 'disable_account'
        timeframe: 72h
    block_ip:
        action: 'block_ip'
        timeframe: 72h
    patch_system:
        action: 'run_playbook'
        playbook: 'patch_critical_cve.yml'
        timeframe: 72h
    condition: quarantine and disable_account and block_ip and patch_system
level: critical

title: Multiple Containment Actions from Same Threat Actor
id: 8a9d8b7c-1f2e-4b5d-9c8a-1b2c3d4e5f6a
